title: Naruto's Lantern Over Dark City
description: A large ornate metal lantern floats in the night sky, its glass panels revealing Naruto Uzumaki with his hand pressed against the surface. Below lies a dark, gothic industrial cityscape with spires, bridges, and smokestacks under a large glowing orange moon.
prompt: A massive ornate rusted metal and glass lantern floats in a purple night sky, inside is Naruto Uzumaki with spiky blonde hair pressing his hand against the cracked glass, black smoke and bats swirling around the lantern, below is a dark gothic industrial city with tall spires, bridges and smokestacks, giant orange full moon in the background, dark surreal atmosphere, detailed digital painting
